rationale: Non-approver can approve payment because role gate is removed

Finance-manager prerequisite is skipped so two non-manager approvers can release high-value payment

Successful void sets status but does not append payment_voided audit event
Inactive session token is treated as active so approval succeeds instead of returning 401
Service returns 401 for inactive token but still appends approval record before exiting
Support summary exposes full account number because masking helper is bypassed
Confidential approval comments are returned to support_readonly users because comment filter is skipped
Delegate can approve after delegation window expiry because end-time validation is skipped
Delegate can create a chained delegation from temporary authority because chained-delegation block is removed
Non-treasury actor can reverse settled payment because treasury-role check is removed
Reversal succeeds without an existing incident ticket because incident lookup is skipped
Service account creates internal transfer without approved mTLS subject because allowlist check is removed
Authorization checks wrong field and trusts service-account name instead of mTLS subject
Structured logs capture full account number because redaction is skipped for payment fields
Unexpected exception logging writes unsanitized payload containing full account number
One payment transition updates state without appending audit event because helper call is removed

Normal execution log includes raw secret fixture value because config payload is logged before sanitization
Exception logger emits raw exception string containing secret fixture
Insufficient-permission approval denial returns 403 but no security audit event is appended
Security audit event is emitted with wrong event type or generic code instead of approval_denied_security
Token remains valid at or beyond 15 minutes because expiry comparator is off by one
Expired token is denied but no document_token_expired audit event is appended
Reconciliation report download succeeds without appending audit record
Audit record uses wrong requester identity such as report owner or default admin instead of acting user
Search log stores raw email string instead of hashed value
Service hashes email without required salt so log value is deterministic across environments
Only successful configuration reads append audit events while denied reads are silent
Denied read is audited but outcome field is always set to allowed
Create-payment validates amount presence only and allows zero or negative values
Upper-bound check is removed so amounts over 100000 are accepted
Scheduled date earlier than request date is accepted because lower-bound check is removed
Scheduled date more than 30 calendar days ahead is accepted because upper-bound check is skipped
Approval path incorrectly requires comment and rejects comment-free valid approvals
Rejection comment minimum length check is removed so short comments are accepted
Beneficiary update accepts both IBAN and account-plus-routing in same request
Beneficiary update rejects valid account_number plus routing_number pair because implementation only accepts IBAN
Attachment upload validates size but not content type so txt or other files are accepted
Attachment size threshold is off by one or skipped so files larger than 5 MB are accepted
Batch payout accepts zero items because minimum-size validation is removed
Duplicate client_reference values are accepted because uniqueness check is removed or normalized incorrectly
Callback URL only checks scheme and accepts non-allowlisted hostname
Callback URL only checks allowlist and accepts http scheme
Refund validator compares request only to captured_amount and ignores prior approved refunds
Refund validator sums denied or pending refunds as approved and rejects valid remaining balance
DRAFT payment submits without line items because line-item precondition is skipped
DRAFT payment submits with unverified beneficiary because verification check is removed
Payment transitions to APPROVED after first approval because required approver count is hardcoded to one
Duplicate approvals from same user count toward threshold because distinct approver logic is missing
Executed payment allows amount or beneficiary edits because mutable-field allowlist is removed
Executed payment rejects reconciliation_note updates as well
Reject path sets status REJECTED but leaves scheduled_execution_at unchanged
Reject path clears schedule but does not change payment status to REJECTED
Approved payment can be canceled because allowed-state check includes APPROVED
Cancel request for APPROVED payment returns 409 but still mutates status to CANCELED
Expired pending delegated task remains pending because expiry processor skips invalidation
Expired pending delegated task becomes INVALID but no delegation_expired event is emitted
Chargeback creation does not set dispute_status to OPEN
Refund path ignores dispute_status and still creates refunds during open chargeback
Any positive refund immediately transitions payment to REFUNDED instead of staying CAPTURED on partial total
Payment never transitions to REFUNDED even when approved refunds exactly equal captured amount
Replay with same idempotency key and same body generates new payment_id because stored-key lookup is skipped
Implementation compares request bodies using unstable serialization and misses identical replay under reordered fields
Reused idempotency key with different body creates second payment instead of returning 409
Reused idempotency key with different body returns original payment_id as if replay were identical
Retrying same approval command records duplicate approval action because command_id dedupe is removed
Command replay dedupe state is cleared after success so later retry is treated as new approval
Duplicate provider message is processed again because receipt store lookup is skipped
Duplicate provider message is ignored but duplicate_ignored event is not appended
Webhook delivery retries on 4xx as well as 5xx because retry classifier is too broad
Webhook delivery continues retrying even after first 200 success
Restarted export job allocates new job_id instead of reusing original identifier
Restarted export replays already written rows because written_set dedupe is removed
Successor worker can acquire lock before stale period exceeds five minutes because threshold check is loosened
Multiple successor workers can take over same stale lock because exclusivity state is not persisted
Duplicate detection compares filename or import_id instead of checksum so repeated content is reapplied
Repeated successful checksum is marked non-duplicate and file contents are applied a second time
Error responses omit correlation_id header while success responses include it
Request log entry gets a fresh correlation_id different from response header
Latency is measured from payment creation time instead of submission time
Latency is recorded on first approval attempt even when payment is not yet terminal
Execution job emits only end event and no start event
End event carries wrong job_id or result copied from request default
Guardrail violation record is emitted without requirement_id field
Blocked request is only logged and no guardrail_violations record is persisted
Provider circuit emits alert on every open call even during same open interval
Provider circuit fails to emit alert when reopened after close because prior-open flag is never reset
Manual override accepts empty reason because non-empty validation is removed
Audit event is appended but affected entity ID is omitted or null
Detected mismatch creates review case but does not increment reconciliation_mismatch_count metric
Detected mismatch increments metric but review case is not created
Completed export job does not emit export_completed event
Completion event records worker identity instead of requester_id
